title: Godrej Properties falls 6% as Q2 profit sinks

timeline.title: Godrej Properties falls 6% as Q2 profit sinks
timeline.line: Profit dropped 62% to ₹154 cr; costs grew faster than a 161% revenue jump
more: Stock fell as much as 6.2% to ₹1,468.40 intraday
Operating expenses up 90.4% to ₹2,477 cr; raw material costs up 32.3%
Management says demand in Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru and NCR remains solid

src.title: Whalesbook: Godrej Properties Q2 profit slumps 62% on high costs
